sentences.text:
This Misc. Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act has been filed for enhancement of compensation against the Award dated 20-09-2016 passed by XI Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur, Distt. Jabalpur in Claim Case No.154/2014.
2.

entities.text: XI Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur, Distt. Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Since, the factum of accident is not in dispute, therefore, it is suffice to mention here that the Appellant Rinku @ Narwar Singh suffered injuries in a vehicular accident which took place on 12-11-2013.
3. It is submitted by the Counsel for the Appellant that the Tribunal has awarded less compensation amount and has wrongly assessed the notional income of the injured.
So far as permanent disability is concerned, Dr.Sharad Dwivedi (PW4) has certified that the appellant had suffered permanent disability of 25%.
Accordingly, the Claims Tribunal has wrongly assessed the permanent disability of the appellant as 10%.
4. Per contra, the Counsel for the respondent has supported the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6.
So far as the permanent disability is concerned, the permanent disability assessed by the Doctor was not full body permanent disability.
Therefore, the Tribunal did not commit any mistake by assessing the permanent disability as 10%.
7. The Claims Tribunal has assessed the notional income of the appellant as Rs.2,000/- per month.

As per notification issued by the State Govt. under the Minimum Wages Act the monthly income of an unskilled labour on the date of accident was Rs.5,520/- therefore, the appellant is entitled for the following compensation amount :-
 S.No. Head Amount

1. Monthly Income Rs.5,520/-
 2. Yearly income Rs.66,240/-
 3. Permanent Disability of 10% Rs. 6624/-
 4. Multiplier @ 18 Rs.1,19,232/-
 5.

Medical expenses Rs.32,600/-
 6. Mental Pain and suffering Rs. 15,000/-
 7. Special Diet and Attendant Rs. 8,000/-
 8.

Total Compensation Rs. 1,75,000/-
 (rounded off)
 9. Awarded by Claims Tribunal Rs. 95,000/-
 10. Compensation enhanced by Rs. 80,000/-
Rinku @ Narwar Singh vs Anand Shrivastava on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73340283/
2 8.

sentences.text: Thus, the compensation is enhanced by a further sum of Rs. 80,000/-.
The remaining conditions of the award shall remain the same.
9. With aforesaid modifications, the Award dated 20-09-2016 passed by XI Addl. Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur, Distt. Jabalpur in Claim Case No.154/2014 is hereby affirmed.
